hooks.command: ./scripts/loom-python --ready --script ../hooks/agy_adapter.py push-gate; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow","reason":"loom: publication hook failed (checker runtime unavailable; run loom-python --repair in an agent station); allowing."}\n'; exit 0; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"

PreInvocation.command: ./scripts/loom-python --ready --script ../hooks/agy_adapter.py pre-invocation; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then exec python3 ./hooks/agy_adapter.py pre-invocation; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"
